name: Ricochet Spine icon
description: UI slot icon for the Ricochet Spine. Composes `ss.proj.card` via `use`, tilted the way the wand icon tilts its dart, so the slot shows the wing membrane itself instead of the old hand-drawn i_card (white rounded rect, red pip).

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_card_evo), derived rather than drawn again.
